paper_title: Revisiting the bound on axion-photon coupling from Globular Clusters
notes: Stellar (globular cluster R-parameter) bound on axion-photon coupling, mass-independent for m_a below a few keV. Main result: g_agamma < 0.66e-10 GeV^-1 at 95% CL (benchmark using Aver et al. He abundance). Encoded as mass-independent horizontal line using sentinel mass 0. Valid for axion masses below ~few keV (Primakoff production). Alternative bounds under other Y assumptions: 0.50e-10 (SBBN), 0.76e-10 (solar He). | selector: text (sole candidate)
